2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch series addresses eight race conditions between memory hotplug and the Linux allocator, which can lead to failed allocations, NULL dereferences, or incorrect placement of pages. The races occur because zonelists are reordered in-place at runtime during hotplug, causing narrow but determinable windows for failure. The patches use a kprobe reproduction module to make these conditions deterministic and fix the issues by synchronizing access to zonelists and preferred zones.
